scene: The bell chimes loudly, opening three departures on the transit platform.
picture: Flat side-view transit platform. Far left, a red steam train waits on tracks with doors open. Left, the girl with long black braid in teal hoodie sits in her purple wheelchair beside the brass bell. Up high, a striped airship floats with a ramp lowered to centre. Far right, an open glass elevator glows.
shown: a red steam train waiting on tracks at the far left with open doors
a striped airship tethered up high with a lowered boarding ramp
a glowing glass elevator shaft standing open on the far right
